groups.title: Active codes — listed on the game page
groups.intro: This row copies the only code string in the Roblox games API description for universe 10771155665, read on 6 Nov 2026. The description says “Use code SANDBOX for $1000.” Dexerto (5 Nov 2026) and Roblox Den (read 6 Nov 2026) also list SANDBOX as active for $1,000 Cash. This wiki did not redeem it in a client.

rows.note: 6 Nov 2026. Printed in the experience description (updated 2026-11-06T04:47:43Z). Trackers call the reward $1,000 Cash. The description writes $1000 and does not add the word Cash. Paste it in the Roblox client, not on this website.
